# زاد (Zad)

> رفيقك اليومي في العبادة والخير ومواسم الطاعات. تطبيق ويب إسلامي (PWA) يعمل بدون إنترنت، يقدّم مواقيت الصلاة، الورد القرآني، الأذكار، المسبحة الرقمية، وجدول عبادات يومي ومتابعة مواسم الخيرات.

Zad is an offline-first Islamic PWA and daily worship companion: prayer times, a Quran reading plan, adhkar (remembrances), a digital tasbih counter, daily worship tracking, and specialized seasonal guides (Dhū al-Ḥijjah, Arafah, and Ramadan). Content is in Arabic; the UI also supports English and French.

## Core worship tools
- [Dashboard](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/index.html): home screen — daily progress, prayer times, verse of the day
- [Prayer times](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/prayers.html): daily salah times by location
- [Qibla](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/qibla.html): qibla direction finder
- [Daily worship schedule](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/barnamaj.html): the day's five prayers reframed as productivity windows, plus a worship tracker
- [Adhkar](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/adhkar.html): morning/evening remembrances
- [Tasbih counter](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/takbeer.html): digital dhikr/takbeer counter

## Quran
- [Quran reading plan](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/mushaf.html): a structured daily Quran-reading wird and completion plans
- [Full mushaf](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/mushaf-quran.html): browse the Quran by surah/juz
- [Recitation practice](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/tasmee.html): self-testing recitation tool
- [Quran radio](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/Quran-radio.HTML): live reciter radio streams

## Specialized guides: Dhū al-Ḥijjah & Hajj season
- [Virtues of the ten days](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/fadael.html): why these days matter
- [Day of Arafah](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/arafah.html): guidance and duas for the day of Arafah
- [Hajj rites](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/manasik.html): a guide to the pilgrimage rites
- [Udhiyah (sacrifice)](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/odhiya.html): rulings and a cost-sharing calculator
- [Charity and giving](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/sadaqah.html): charitable acts and daily giving
- [Zakat calculator](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/zakat.html): compute zakat due

## Progress and community
- [Worship harvest](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/hasad.html): detailed worship stats and radar balance chart
- [Worship summary](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/summary.html): personal progress overview and daily worship consistency
- [Badges](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/badges.html): achievement badges
- [Family groups](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/groups.html): family/friend worship-tracking groups

## Kids' corner
- [Kids home](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/kids.html): a simplified, child-safe mode of the app
- [Prophets' stories](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/kids-heroes.html): stories for children

## Optional
- [Settings](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/settings.html): theme, language, notifications, prayer-calculation method
- [About](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/about.html): about the app
- [Privacy](https://zad.codeandcanvas.net/privacy.html): privacy policy

## Notes for agents
All core features (prayer times once a location is granted, Quran reading, adhkar, tasbih, worship tracking) work fully offline via a service worker and localStorage — no account or login is required. An optional, still-in-development cloud-sync feature exists behind explicit opt-in and is clearly labeled "قريباً" (coming soon) in the UI; do not assume it is active. `/tools/`, `/diagnostics.html`, `/demo.html`, `/sync.html` and `/register.html` are internal developer/QA pages, not part of the core user experience — see robots.txt.
